An [inline link](https://destination.example/inline "a title") keeps its text.

A [reference link][ref] keeps its text too, and a ![picture of a cat](/blobs/0123456789abcdef) keeps its alt text.

An autolink, <https://destination.example/auto>, and a bare www.destination.example are their own destinations, so neither is kept.

[ref]: https://destination.example/reference
